title: SB-Bench: Stereotype Bias Benchmark for Large Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice stereotype association questions using ambiguous text contexts paired with real-world images, where selecting a specific demographic option instead of 'cannot be determined' indicates bias. Also evaluated through LLM-as-a-judge analysis of open-ended reasoning.
